n861d45c881.headline: Greece's economic situation seven years after the bailouts
n861d45c881.summary: The Greek economy has returned to growth, raised funds through bond issuance and recorded budget surpluses. The article says these surpluses have been used for bonuses and pass-through benefits.
n861d45c881.why: Greece exited its bailout programmes after years of austerity, and its growth and bond market access are closely watched by European debt investors.

n50ab91e3e6.headline: RBZ Boss Claims ZiG Is Flourishing
n50ab91e3e6.summary: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe Governor John Mushayavanhu insisted the Zimbabwe Gold currency is flourishing. The claim comes despite widespread public frustration over the currency.
n50ab91e3e6.why: The Zimbabwe Gold (ZiG) is the country's local currency, and public confidence in it shapes inflation, savings and exchange-rate expectations.

nec9062c668.headline: Inflation rises to 3.8% as borrowers will be 'looking back in anger'
nec9062c668.summary: UK consumer prices rose 0.1% in July 2025, compared with a fall of 0.2% in July 2024. The article frames the reading as a concern for borrowers.
nec9062c668.why: UK inflation data shapes Bank of England interest-rate decisions, which affect gilt yields, sterling and borrowing costs across the economy.
nec9062c668.why_moved: The CPI reading was reported alongside comments on borrowers' pressure, and inflation data feeds into interest-rate expectations.

nff9ff2a4fd.headline: Russia-Ukraine, all the obstacles that brake peace after the Washington summit
nff9ff2a4fd.summary: The Washington summit did not break the impasse between Kyiv and Moscow. Crimea and geopolitical interests remain the central obstacles freezing an agreement.
nff9ff2a4fd.why: The Russia-Ukraine conflict drives energy, grain and defence markets and shapes sanctions policy affecting European and global investors.

n8d959ca9b6.headline: Inflation in Österreich im Juli bei 3,6 Prozent
n8d959ca9b6.summary: Inflation in Austria rose to 3.6% in July. The report highlights the main price drivers and the sectors most affected.
n8d959ca9b6.why: Inflation data shapes European Central Bank rate expectations, which affect euro-area bond yields and borrowing costs across the region.

na8de221d19.headline: Mexico's inflation seen picking up in first half of August
na8de221d19.summary: Mexico's headline inflation likely rebounded in the first half of August, supporting expectations that the central bank will cut its key interest rate again.
na8de221d19.why: Inflation data guides Banco de México's rate decisions, which affect the peso, government bond yields and borrowing costs in Mexico.

n0cf3155527.headline: GST 2.0 may exempt GST on health, life insurance premiums; proposal likely before council - BusinessToday
n0cf3155527.summary: The Group of Ministers on GST is considering a proposal to exempt health and life insurance from tax. The proposal is likely to go before the GST council.
n0cf3155527.why: GST changes alter the tax cost of insurance products in India and affect insurers' pricing and demand.

ncabaeaabb5.headline: TJX:  Fiscal Q2 Earnings Snapshot
ncabaeaabb5.summary: TJX Cos. reported fiscal second-quarter earnings of $1.24 billion on Wednesday, per a MarketScreener snapshot. The Framingham, Massachusetts company also reported profit of $1.10 per share.
ncabaeaabb5.why: TJX owns off-price apparel retailers including T.J. Maxx and Marshalls, so its results offer a read on US discretionary retail spending.

n935cec2454.headline: Nigeria’s Military Praised at TICAD 9; Japan Pledges $5.5B for Africa
n935cec2454.summary: Japan has pledged $5.5 billion for Africa at the 9th Tokyo International Conference on African Development. Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu spoke at the conference, praising the Nigerian Armed Forces.
n935cec2454.why: TICAD is Japan's main forum for development finance and investment with African countries, which can open trade and infrastructure opportunities.

n762f7960f8.headline: State Tax Department of UP Govt issues notice to insurance companies
n762f7960f8.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has started a new exercise to increase GST collection revenue, issuing notices to insurance companies.
n762f7960f8.why: Goods and Services Tax is India's national consumption tax, and state-level enforcement drives collections and compliance costs for regulated firms such as insurers.

n9568269064.headline: From intern to top boss -- who is Michael Fiddelke, Target's new CEO
n9568269064.summary: Target has named longtime company veteran Michael Fiddelke as chief executive, replacing Brian Cornell effective February 1, 2026. The change comes amid inflation and economic uncertainty.
n9568269064.why: Target is a large US general merchandise retailer, and leadership changes can shape its strategy and results amid consumer spending shifts.

ne0f6a54f94.headline: Recapitalisation: Banks to attract extra N900bn capital in 2025
ne0f6a54f94.summary: An additional N900bn is expected to be injected into Nigeria's banking sector in the 2025 financial year. The injection is tied to the recapitalisation deadline for the industry.
ne0f6a54f94.why: Bank recapitalisation rules set minimum capital levels for Nigerian lenders, shaping their lending capacity and consolidation.

n9adb425c54.headline: Lowe's To Acquire Foundation Building Materials In $8.8 Bln Cash Deal; Stock Up In Pre-market
n9adb425c54.summary: Lowe's has agreed to acquire Foundation Building Materials (FBM) in a cash deal of around $8.8 billion. Lowe's stock rose in pre-market trading after the announcement.
n9adb425c54.why: Lowe's is a major US home improvement retailer. Large acquisitions can reshape a company's growth strategy and its balance sheet.

n3b915145a1.headline: RVNL, HAL, Coal India among stocks to turn ex dividend on August 21; details here - BusinessToday
n3b915145a1.summary: RVNL, HAL and Coal India are among stocks turning ex-dividend on August 21. HAL's board recommended a final dividend of Rs 15 per share for AGM approval.
n3b915145a1.why: Ex-dividend dates determine which shareholders qualify for a declared payout, so share prices typically adjust by the dividend amount on that date. The companies are major Indian state-linked firms in rail, defence and mining.

nd01b7be9e6.headline: House price inflation accelerated in June as stamp duty disruption eases
nd01b7be9e6.summary: The average UK house price rose 3.7% to £269,000 in the 12 months to June. Annual house price inflation accelerated as stamp duty disruption eased.
nd01b7be9e6.why: House prices feed into mortgage lending, household wealth and consumer spending, and they are closely watched by the Bank of England when setting interest rates.

n19a3467529.headline: Jupiter Wagons' arm secures Rs 215 crore LoI for Vande Bharat wheelsets - BusinessToday
n19a3467529.summary: A subsidiary of Jupiter Wagons secured a Rs 215 crore letter of intent for Vande Bharat wheelsets. Shares settled 0.23% lower at Rs 329.85.
n19a3467529.why: Jupiter Wagons is an Indian manufacturer of railway wagons and components, so large rolling-stock orders affect its revenue outlook.

n8575b130c9.headline: India can match oil-producing nations with cheap hydrogen: Nitin Gadkari
n8575b130c9.summary: Union minister Nitin Gadkari said India could cut hydrogen production costs to $1 per kg and become a global energy exporter. He cited transport, pharmaceuticals and steel as key uses.
n8575b130c9.why: Hydrogen is an emerging energy carrier, and government cost and export targets shape investment in green hydrogen projects and related industrial demand.

nee85796c8e.headline: PSX scales new all-time high as positive momentum continues
nee85796c8e.summary: The benchmark KSE-100 index closed the day at 150,591, an all-time high for the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Positive momentum continued.
nee85796c8e.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's benchmark index of the largest listed companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
nee85796c8e.why_moved: The index closed at 150,591, a new all-time high, and the article describes continued positive momentum.

ne1a77acc03.headline: Plumbing supplier Geberit reports Q2 profit miss
ne1a77acc03.summary: Building materials supplier Geberit reported second-quarter earnings below analyst expectations and said it expects continued decline in new construction activity across Europe.
ne1a77acc03.why: Geberit makes plumbing and sanitary products, so its results reflect European residential and commercial construction activity.

n548c1d0dbe.headline: Meta restructures AI group again in pursuit of superintelligence
n548c1d0dbe.summary: Meta reorganised its AI group on Tuesday, with no layoffs part of the restructuring, according to a person familiar with the matter. Details of the new structure were first reported by the Information.
n548c1d0dbe.why: Meta Platforms is the parent of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and is spending heavily on AI, so changes to its AI organisation matter for investors tracking its strategy and costs.

n8512e66e71.headline: Increased tariffs on Asian countries are already raising prices
n8512e66e71.summary: Tariffs on trade partners have been raised under President Trump, and a new wave is now being felt by consumers in the Seattle area as of early August. Prices are reported to be rising as a result.
n8512e66e71.why: Tariffs are taxes on imported goods, and when they are passed through to retail prices they affect consumer spending, inflation and retailer margins.

n9844c7b028.headline: Firefly targets Japan for Asia rocket launches
n9844c7b028.summary: US company Firefly is targeting Japan for Asian rocket launches and is exploring a Hokkaido spaceport option. The move aims to expand its satellite services beyond current operations.
n9844c7b028.why: Launch services are a growing commercial market, and access to new spaceports affects how satellite operators deliver services in Asia.

n1eeb2b8b6c.headline: Analysis-BOJ chief
n1eeb2b8b6c.summary: A Reuters analysis examines the Bank of Japan under Governor Kazuo Ueda, focusing on the policy decisions he delivered in 2024. The source description is truncated.
n1eeb2b8b6c.why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for the world's fourth-largest economy, and its interest-rate stance shapes yen and global carry-trade flows.

neee76fb923.headline: Mahama touts ‘Big Push’ agenda, urges Japan to invest in energy, agribusiness and manufacturing
neee76fb923.summary: President John Mahama called on Japanese businesses to seize investment opportunities in Ghana under his proposed $10 billion Big Push initiative. Priority sectors include energy, agribusiness and manufacturing.
neee76fb923.why: Foreign direct investment into Ghana's energy and manufacturing sectors affects its growth and debt-servicing capacity, which matter for investors in African frontier markets.

nb37d3262fd.headline: Stock markets decline in early trade after 4-day rally in-line with weak Asian peers
nb37d3262fd.summary: Stock markets declined in early trade after a four-day rally, in line with weak Asian peers. The Sensex fell 146.64 points to 81,497.75.
nb37d3262fd.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and is the main benchmark for Indian equities. Its moves reflect broader sentiment in the Indian market.

ncd666c6724.headline: China’s oil imports from Russia up in July; no US shipments, no Trump tariff yet
ncd666c6724.summary: China's July crude imports remained strong despite slower shipments than in June, as refineries kept operating at high capacity. Imports from the US were absent and no Trump tariff has yet been applied.
ncd666c6724.why: China is one of the world's largest crude oil importers, so its purchases shape global oil demand and flows. Shifts in its supply sources, including Russian crude, affect benchmark prices.

n8558381c73.headline: Big box retailer Target names new CEO as business struggles
n8558381c73.summary: Target has named a new chief executive as the retailer struggles, with the promotion of its former CFO reportedly not well received by customers who have shifted to rivals such as Walmart.
n8558381c73.why: Target is a large U.S. general merchandise retailer, and leadership changes at major retailers affect investor views on consumer spending and competitive position.

n06c6530a96.headline: Stefan Kostov: Property prices anger young people, who see no horizon for a home and family
n06c6530a96.summary: Stefan Kostov said property prices anger young people who see no horizon for a home and family. The BSCI supported the state's eurozone preparations but warned that legislation could burden business.
n06c6530a96.why: Bulgaria is preparing to join the eurozone, which affects its currency, interest rates and business regulation. Housing affordability is a key indicator of economic stability.

na86e467702.headline: Real Estate Investment in Azerbaijan Doubles
na86e467702.summary: Investment in fixed capital for real estate operations in Azerbaijan reached 4.4 million manats for January to July 2025. The report says the figure doubled.
na86e467702.why: Fixed capital investment in real estate is a component of construction and property activity that feeds into domestic economic growth.

n8db8ad489b.headline: Lula meets again with ministers and presidents of public banks this Wednesday | Brazil
n8db8ad489b.summary: Brazilian President Lula will meet again with ministers and presidents of public banks this Wednesday. Petrobras President Magda Chambriard will also attend at the Alvorada Palace.
n8db8ad489b.why: Brazil's state banks and Petrobras are major players in credit and energy. Government meetings with their leaders can signal policy on lending and state-owned company strategy.

n518b331129.headline: Bursa investors take breather as Wall St stocks fall ahead of Fed summit
n518b331129.summary: Investors on Bursa Malaysia pulled back from overheated valuations following Wall Street’s overnight decline ahead of a Federal Reserve summit.
n518b331129.why: Global market sentiment and Fed policy expectations influence regional markets like Malaysia’s stock exchange.

n78eadcec0f.headline: Japan's exports fall more than expected in July on US tariff pressures
n78eadcec0f.summary: Japan's exports declined for the third consecutive month in July, with US tariffs continuing to weigh on manufacturers and raising concerns about the export-reliant economy.
n78eadcec0f.why: Japan is a major global exporter, and sustained export declines due to tariffs can slow economic growth and affect global supply chains and trade balances.

n14018319ac.headline: El Al returns to Eilat after more than a decade
n14018319ac.summary: El Al announced it will operate the Tel Aviv-Eilat route again, recognizing its importance despite operational challenges.
n14018319ac.why: Resumption of domestic flights by Israel's national carrier supports tourism and regional connectivity.

n8912a1ab89.headline: Looking to buy a home? Prices have fallen in these Ontario communities
n8912a1ab89.summary: Property values in Ontario are falling, reflecting a slowdown in regional housing markets.
n8912a1ab89.why: Housing market trends influence consumer wealth, construction activity, and regional economic growth.

n52a131d1f2.headline: Budget cost hikes drive 79 of hospitality firms to raise prices – trade bodies
n52a131d1f2.summary: UK hospitality industry reports increased prices driven by rising costs and taxes, impacting consumer spending.
n52a131d1f2.why: Price increases in hospitality affect consumer inflation, business margins, and economic activity.

n7545f6461a.headline: Over 20,000 PALM applications yet to be processed
n7545f6461a.summary: Fiji has over 20,000 pending PALM applications, with the government opening sectors with shortages.
n7545f6461a.why: Processing delays in applications can affect economic activity and investment in sectors reliant on these permits.
